name: ui/mzizi-trust-meter
title: MziziTrustMeter
summary: The expanded view of trust: the composite score as a role="meter" named by its level, then either the three-signal breakdown (Verification, Status, Ubuntu) or, with `signals`, one row per counted signal for an address, a place or a venue. Raw scores are written only with `showScore`. Server-rendered; the bars are SVG geometry.

props.name: trustScore
props.description: The composite trust score, 0.000 to 1.000. It is the meter's aria-valuenow and the bar's width; it is written to three decimals only with `showScore`.

props.name: verificationScore
props.description: The Verification signal, 0 to 1. Its bar always shows; its value is written only with `showScore`.

props.name: statusScore
props.description: The platform status modifier (-0.05 to 0.05), shown normalised around 0.5. Negative reads as an error colour.

props.name: ubuntuPoints
props.description: Ubuntu points, a raw count, shown beside the Ubuntu signal and in a line under the breakdown.

props.name: tierLabel
props.description: The verification tier's name, beside the Verification signal.

props.name: statusLabel
props.description: The platform status's name, beside the Status signal.

props.name: compact
props.description: The header and the meter bar alone, with no breakdown and no signal list.

props.name: title
props.description: The meter's name, shown and used as its accessible name (the default reads "Trust score").

props.name: signals
props.type: { label: string; count: number; detail?: string }[]
props.description: Counted signals ("Check-ins at the entrance", 12). With them the meter lists one row per signal instead of the three-signal breakdown.

props.name: showScore
props.description: Write the raw scores: the composite to three decimals over "/ 1.000" and each breakdown signal's value. Off by default (#543, matching mzizi-verified-badge since #550): the header names the level instead (Strong, Growing, Low, None).

props.name: class
props.description: Extra classes on the root, merged last.

behaviour: The root is role="meter" with aria-valuemin 0, aria-valuemax 1 and aria-valuenow the trust score, and its aria-label is the title ("Trust score" for the default title). Without `showScore` it also has aria-valuetext, the level's name.

The level is strong from 0.4, growing from 0.2, low from 0.05 and none below. The header names it (Strong, Growing, Low, None) in the level colour: success for strong, warning for growing and low, neutral for none. The bar's width is the score, in the same colour.
With `showScore`, the header writes the score to three decimals over "/ 1.000" in place of the level name, and each breakdown signal writes its value.

Without `signals`, the Verification, Status and Ubuntu signals each show a bar (and, with `showScore`, their value); the Status modifier is shown normalised around 0.5, in the error colour when negative. `ubuntuPoints` adds a line under the breakdown.
With `signals`, the breakdown is replaced by a <ul> with one 44px row per signal: its label, its optional detail and its count.
`compact` shows the header and the bar only.
Bars are SVG <rect> widths in a 0–100 viewBox, so the component needs no inline style and no script.

score.description: The raw scores written out, for a trust audit.

suspended.description: A negative status modifier and a score under 0.05.

aria: role="meter" with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax and aria-valuenow, named by aria-label (the title); without `showScore`, aria-valuetext is the level's name.
The bars and icons are aria-hidden; the level (or, with `showScore`, every value) is also written as text.

theming.brandOverlay: None: the score and the Verification and Status signals use the --status-* tokens, and the Ubuntu signal is tanzanite in every brand, because it names the Ubuntu axis, not the brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the meter is rendered on the server.

responsive: The meter fills its container; a signal's label truncates rather than pushing its count out.
contract:
contract
  slot is "mzizi-trust-meter"
  role is "meter"
  portal is "https://mzizi.dev/components/mzizi-trust-meter"
  label is "Trust score"
  when default shows span "Trust Score"
  when signals label is "Address trust"
  when signals shows span "Deliveries completed"
  when suspended class contains "bg-card"
end

checks.say: The meter exposes its value and range.
The signals meter is named by its title and carries its value.
By default the header names the level and writes no score.
By default no raw score is written.
By default the meter's value text is the level.
With showScore, the score is written to three decimals.
With showScore, each breakdown signal writes its value.
The bar is an SVG rect as wide as the score.
With signals, one row per signal and no breakdown.
Compact shows no list and no breakdown.
A negative status modifier is in the error colour.
A score under 0.05 names the level None, in the neutral colour.
The skeleton is a named meter with no value.

gaps: Before #543 the React build was a client component with the harness's enter animation (an inline animation style). The contract forbids inline style and needs no script, so neither build animates in; a motion utility class would bring it back.
